I'm your host, Darren Van Dam!

The recent success of Obsession got me thinking what other micro budget movies embarrassed big blockbusters at the box office. While this is rare, there have been some absolute bangers over the years produced, shot and released for what amounts to pocket change in the film industry. Amazing movies that launched stellar careers, in most cases... and they all did it for a fraction of what it cost Hollywood to make a bad movie.
